name: Gyrogrill
notes: 5 photos: photo 1 and photo 5 are two printed revisions of the same full menu board (mezes/entrees/gyros/plates/souvlaki/sides/meat/sweets) with different prices; used photo 1 as the base and skipped photo 5's duplicate items to avoid mixing price sets. Photo 3 is a third board (soup/meat/skewers/sides/sweets/drinks/add-ons/specials) at yet another price point that overlaps photo 1's items but was used only for its unique sections (Specials, Melomakarino, Drinks) not present on photo 1. Photo 2 is a separate pink breakfast menu, added as its own section. Photo 4 is a photo/chalkboard combo of named 'Gyro Creations' with ingredients but no prices, added with prices omitted. Add-on modifiers (feta cheese, grilled onions, extra sauce, etc.) and protein/meal-side choice lists were skipped as modifiers, not dishes. Ambiguous per-item pricing for the Sautéed Vegetables/Stewed Dandelion Greens/Baked Garbanzo Beans a-la-carte sides (single price line spanning multiple rows) was left without a price rather than guessed.
